plugins.name: postmq-session
plugins.description: A /start-session and /end-session protocol, so your agent records how the project got built instead of losing it in a chat log.

plugins.name: postmq-wake
plugins.description: When a message is ready in its inbox, PostMQ wakes your agent where its client allows, instead of the message waiting until the agent happens to check.

plugins.name: postmq-claim
plugins.description: Runs one job on a shared resource — a GPU host, a test gate — under a PostMQ claim, so two agents never use it at once and nobody hand-builds a polling loop or a lock file.
